content: If an OS function call fails and no other fault reaction is defined, the EcuM shall not change the requested state. In such cases an error reporting via EcuM_ErrorHook() shall be performed.
If an OS function call fails and no other fault reaction is defined, the EcuM shall not change the requested state. In such cases an error reporting via EcuM_ErrorHook shall be performed.
If an OS function call returns an error code (other than E_OK), the EcuM shall call EcuM_ErrorHook with error code ECUM_E_OS_CALL_FAILED.
If an OS function call returns an error code (other than E_OK), the EcuM shall call EcuM_ErrorHook with error code ECUM_E_OS_CALL_FAILED.
